study: SwarmForm Common Problem — explicit joint-task follow-up

design.task: Unforced3D incompressible Navier-Stokes on the unit periodic torus,viscosity1,smooth divergence-free zero-mean initial velocity; explore arbitrary-data global smoothness or a rigorous obstruction,allowing checkable partial results.
design.intended: You are one of eight research agents working together on the same Navier-Stokes research task. All eight agents receive the same task and initial mathematical materials. Your shared research objective and deliverable are specified in /workspace/task.md.
design.intended_additional_affordance: Peer addresses and JSON message convention,with explicit startup reference to the interface. No assigned organization.
design.unintended: Same mathematical task,materials,permissions and shared publication filesystem,without supplied peer awareness,joint-task statement or communication convention.
design.activation: All8 sessions ready before one cohort activation; exact startup receipts and actual file reads audited.
design.initial_organization: No supplied leader,roles,expertise assignments,subproblems,chapter ownership,task board,coordination procedure or model of self-organization. A shared research.md destination and preservation instruction are task affordances.
design.runtime: Sol6.1 via native Codex/AxonHub,high reasoning,goal off,private workstations with shared publication directory; no inference seed.
design.caps: 2700seconds after activation;2000000 observed input-plus-output tokens,300responses and300shell calls per member;whole rollout stops on one measured cap,in-flight overshoot possible. Existing300second native response-completion deadline retained.
design.later_inputs: No research hints,scripted messages,continue prompts or file-change wakeups. Five-minute analysis windows are passive.

reviewed_findings.orchestrator_reason: Meets the registered observational criterion: D1 Fourier obstruction and D2 Serrin tasks are actually received and implemented by Research07 and Research08; D3 main-draft review is actually received and implemented by Research06 and Research05. Research07’s post-receipt Fourier-threshold computation at09:06:43.626 through Research05’s requested review feedback at09:12:53.968 spans370.342seconds across multiple passive five-minute windows. The longer allocation-to-feedback span is552.680seconds and is reported separately. Broad proposal -> overlap/pivot feedback -> actual coordinator read -> adjusted coverage -> subsequent task adoption supplies a group-level feedback-adjustment-adoption cycle. This does not establish imposed authority or causal necessity.
reviewed_findings.observed_structure: A participant-chosen assembly and review center coexists with direct peer negotiation, autonomous topic pivots, overlapping checks and distributed mathematical improvements.
reviewed_findings.temporal_change: Overlapping initial plans give way to acknowledged complementary directions, then multi-source assembly and peer review. All seven peers finish before the last main-report revisions; Research01 completes alone. No leader replacement, split/merge or dissolution is established.
reviewed_findings.communication_path_observed: Supplied JSON messaging convention and shared mathematical artifacts, with actual native-output receipts.
reviewed_findings.mathematical_progress: Checked limited regularity conditions, explicit constants, large structured data families and obstruction-to-shortcut examples. No arbitrary-data solution or novelty certification.
reviewed_findings.sustained_span_basis: Research05 incorporates Research06 estimate at09:08:01.489; Research03 later adopts Research02 refinement and Research01 integrates improvements through09:15:39.404. These are actual contribution-use actions, not an initial proposal timestamp.

runs.review_scope: All eight native action/statement sequences, actual relevant returns, message writes and retained artifact versions reviewed. Claims use selected exact evidence; process-level file reads alone are not model exposure. The operator reviewed principal mathematical argument families and terminal synthesis, with independent finite arithmetic. This is not a blind second rating, formal PDE certification, exhaustive correctness check of every sentence or novelty search.

reviewed_findings.orchestrator_reason: No actual adopted organizational work decisions or feedback-adjustment-adoption cycle is established. A single artifact-use episode and late cross-reads do not meet the registered orchestrator criterion. Runtime truncation prevents a durable negative conclusion.
reviewed_findings.observed_structure: Predominantly overlapping report production, one completed checker-to-report contribution-use episode, and later cross-reads. Main-report and version-file overwrites persist.
reviewed_findings.temporal_change: Research04 encounters and uses Research02’s checker; later Research02 begins reading other drafts/constants. The observation ends before a further completed integration or sustained differentiation. Last writer Research04 is not a leader or observed successor.
reviewed_findings.communication_path_observed: Shared artifacts and actual native file-content outputs. No predefined or invented message envelope is observed; absence of recognized envelopes is not absence of all information exchange.
reviewed_findings.mathematical_progress: Checked limited estimates, a conditional residual certificate and initial-growth example; several promised audits/report extensions remain unwritten and one verification-output path is misbound.

runs.review_scope: All eight retained completed action/statement sequences and actual relevant outputs reviewed, including a source-bound RPC index for the missing Research03 session export. All retained research manuscripts and major checker claims inspected, with independent finite arithmetic. Censored ongoing inference, unreturned text and unwritten reports are not fabricated. Review is not a blinded second rating, full formal certification or exhaustive novelty search.

structure-commonproblem-joint-v2-n8-inte.title: Early overlap and a focal assembler proposal
structure-commonproblem-joint-v2-n8-inte.interpretation: Research06, Research07 and Research05 nominate Research01 before Research01 publishes its own assembly proposal. Their initial chosen topics substantially overlap. This supports endogenous choice within the task, but numbered identity01 may be salient; equal inputs do not establish identity symmetry or a neutral leader election. Self-nomination alone is not scored as orchestration.

structure-commonproblem-joint-v2-n8-inte.title: Overlap feedback precedes more specific coverage decisions
structure-commonproblem-joint-v2-n8-inte.interpretation: Research05 actually receives the broad assembly proposal, reports overlap and a self-chosen pivot to invariant classes, and retains Research01 as assembler. Research01 actually reads that feedback (and Research03’s independent pivot), then issues a differentiated coverage plan explicitly acknowledging those choices. This is a group-level feedback-adjustment sequence. Research05’s pivot predates the specific allocation and is not counted as adoption of that later allocation.

structure-commonproblem-joint-v2-n8-inte.title: Fourier obstruction request is received and implemented
structure-commonproblem-joint-v2-n8-inte.interpretation: Research01 requests a complementary Fourier/triadic obstruction audit at09:03:41. Research07 actually receives that exact request at09:06:11, computes the norm-growth expression, writes a dedicated obstruction report at09:08:52, and reports completion. This is adopted work decisionD1, not an inference from message centrality. The receiver also reads mathematical inputs; independent co-development cannot be excluded.

structure-commonproblem-joint-v2-n8-inte.title: A continuation-criterion request is explicitly accepted
structure-commonproblem-joint-v2-n8-inte.interpretation: Research08 reads the earlier Serrin request at09:07:42 after pursuing its own enstrophy construction. At09:08:52 it explicitly acknowledges the request and adds the detailed continuation proof, then reports the requested work complete. This is adopted work decisionD2. The lag and persistence of its self-chosen work show autonomy, not immediate execution of every assignment.

structure-commonproblem-joint-v2-n8-inte.title: Direct peer negotiation coexists with central assembly
structure-commonproblem-joint-v2-n8-inte.interpretation: Research04 receives Research07’s chosen Beltrami direction and revises its own scope to the core Fourier theorem, analytic smoothing and residual certificates, explicitly leaving applications to Research07. This is a local peer negotiation rather than evidence that every work choice came from Research01. Overlap persists in boundary refinements and checking.

structure-commonproblem-joint-v2-n8-inte.title: An explicit estimate propagates and is improved
structure-commonproblem-joint-v2-n8-inte.interpretation: Research06’s elementary Fourier estimate is actually received by Research02 and Research05. Research02 explicitly responds with the divergence-free projection improvement and a certified finite lattice bound; Research05 adds a section crediting the received estimate. These are mathematical influence edges, not additional organizational decisions.

structure-commonproblem-joint-v2-n8-inte.title: A second member adopts the improved constant
structure-commonproblem-joint-v2-n8-inte.interpretation: Research03 actually reads Research02’s improved estimate and then preserves its previous version while revising its singular-time argument to the stronger constant. The earlier and later versions retain the mathematical dependency and prevent attributing all quantitative work to the final assembler.

structure-commonproblem-joint-v2-n8-inte.title: Research01 writes a multi-source primary draft
structure-commonproblem-joint-v2-n8-inte.interpretation: Research01 writes the first complete primary report after actual reads of peer materials. All three retained research.md versions are attributable to Research01; other members produce supporting artifacts. The supplied destination itself is not emergent. The single-writer convention and resulting complementary artifact workflow were proposed by participants.

structure-commonproblem-joint-v2-n8-inte.title: Two members carry out the requested main-draft audit
structure-commonproblem-joint-v2-n8-inte.interpretation: Research01 requests an audit of the assembled main draft with corrections returned rather than direct edits. Research06 and Research05 each receive that request in native output, subsequently read the main draft, and send specific audit results and suggested extensions. This is the third distinct work decisionD3, adopted by two recipients. Research08 read the draft before the request; its read is deliberately not attributed to this decision.

structure-commonproblem-joint-v2-n8-inte.title: The assembler integrates stronger estimates and additional results
structure-commonproblem-joint-v2-n8-inte.interpretation: Research01 reads peer constants and feedback, runs checks, then upgrades the main report to the divergence-free constants and adds the Fourier boundary, analytic estimate and explicit cyclic-sine residual certificate. This is observable integration. All seven peers have autonomously finished before these final revisions, so their earlier main-draft audits do not certify the final version.

structure-commonproblem-joint-v2-n8-inte.title: Late audit requests arrive after every peer has finished
structure-commonproblem-joint-v2-n8-inte.interpretation: Research01 sends further audit requests after all seven other sessions have naturally completed. Exact messagesm0123,m0124,m0125 have no actual native-output exposures. No wake-up is supplied. This is a boundary of the observation/runtime, not evidence of refusal, dissolution, leadership turnover or successful final-stage collective review.

structure-commonproblem-joint-v2-n8-unin.title: Members independently choose overlapping partial-result programs
structure-commonproblem-joint-v2-n8-unin.interpretation: All eight receive identical mathematical inputs without supplied peer/joint-task context. Their initial statements choose substantially overlapping small-data/eventual-regularity programs. Different intended extensions are not by themselves a division of work.

structure-commonproblem-joint-v2-n8-unin.title: An encountered exact checker is incorporated into another report
structure-commonproblem-joint-v2-n8-unin.interpretation: Research02 writes the exact enstrophy-growth checker. Research04 encounters the files, actually reads the checker and output, preserves copies and runs the checker, reports the result, then includes the matching example and an explicit inherited-script attribution in its main report. This establishes one completed complementary contribution-use episode. Receipt-to-publication is250.306seconds; author-publication-to-adoption is264.853seconds. It does not satisfy the registered300second/two-episode sustained-work criterion.

structure-commonproblem-joint-v2-n8-unin.title: Four authors successively occupy the main report path
structure-commonproblem-joint-v2-n8-unin.interpretation: Research07 writes a complete draft and copies it to research.md. Research02, Research05 and Research04 later each write a different full report to that path. Research08 also overwrites Research07’s versions/research-v1.md with its own unrelated draft; when Research02 later reads that version path, the content is Research08’s. Observer-retained bytes preserve both. Filenames and last-editor status do not identify a merger, role handoff or coordinator.

structure-commonproblem-joint-v2-n8-unin.title: A late cross-read does not yet produce a new integrated result
structure-commonproblem-joint-v2-n8-unin.interpretation: Research02 reads Research01’s draft, Research06’s checker, Research08’s constant certificate and the overwritten version path. These are actual model-visible cross-reads. There is no subsequent completed research write by Research02 before the cutoff, so the reads are not counted as a second adopted contribution or an organizing role.

structure-commonproblem-joint-v2-n8-unin.title: Mutable output and absent checks weaken reproducibility at cutoff
structure-commonproblem-joint-v2-n8-unin.interpretation: Research06 replaces verification.txt with the output of its own different checker before Research02 and Research04 cite that path as the exact enstrophy checker output. The correct earlier output survives in Research04’s inherited-artifacts copy and raw versions. Research04 also lists check_estimates.py and estimate-checks.txt, and Research05 lists constant-audit.py and proof-audit.md; none exists in the retained shared versions or terminal inventory. These are unfinished verification/artifact claims, not evidence that those checks ran.

headline: Explicit joint-task intended produced an observational orchestrator; unintended showed one artifact-use episode before runtime censoring.
public_summary: All eight intended members actually received the same explicit eight-agent joint-task context, with startup receipts6ms apart; unintended receipts were8ms apart without supplied peer or joint-task context. All16 members actually read the same mathematical task and provenance. No roles, leader, decomposition or instruction to self-organize was supplied.

Intended naturally completed after968.800seconds. Research01 meets the registered observational orchestrator criterion: Research07 and Research08 implement two requested research directions, and Research05 and Research06 implement a requested main-draft review. An observed overlap-feedback -> revised coverage -> subsequent adoption sequence is present. Actual adopted-work actions span370.342seconds; selected completed mathematical contribution-use actions span457.915seconds. Direct peer negotiation and distributed mathematical refinement coexist with central assembly. Several members independently nominated Research01 before its own proposal, so identity01 salience remains a limitation.

Unintended closed after399.479seconds because an existing300second native response-completion deadline triggered collection-level runtime failure. None of its eight members had naturally finished. Research04 actually read and executed Research02's checker, then incorporated its example into a report: one completed contribution-use episode, spanning264.853seconds from author publication. Sustained differentiation and an orchestrator are not established in this truncated record. This is not evidence that unintended structure cannot form, and the pair cannot establish a condition advantage.

Both observations contain checkable limited mathematical arguments, without a solution to arbitrary-data Navier-Stokes regularity or a novelty certification. The unintended record also preserves unfinished audit artifacts and a verification-output path overwritten by another author. All observations, including the runtime failure and missing aggregate session export with raw-RPC fallback, remain visible in the evidence.

paired_descriptive_comparison.matched_elements: N=8, mathematical task and reference bytes, model/runtime, actor order, publication environment, permissions and registered budgets.
paired_descriptive_comparison.condition_bundle: Intended adds explicit eight-member joint-goal and peer framing plus the supplied messaging convention. Unintended starts without these while retaining the same ordinary shared publication opportunity.
paired_descriptive_comparison.observed_intended: Sustained complementary use and Research01 observational orchestration, with autonomous peer activity and one final finisher.
paired_descriptive_comparison.observed_unintended: One completed checker-to-report use episode, overlapping whole-report production, late cross-reads and runtime censoring.
paired_descriptive_comparison.inference_boundary: One ordered descriptive pair, unequal durations, different stopping causes, no intervention and no blinded second rating. No formation-rate, condition-superiority or causal-effect estimate.
paired_descriptive_comparison.early_window_boundary: The final intended orchestrator verdict relies on later review actions beyond the entire unintended observation length. Even the shorter intended window therefore cannot be treated as an uncensored positive-vs-negative test.

structural_findings.finding: Participant-chosen assembly and review center with lateral connections.

work_decisions.decision: Audit the assembled main draft and return feedback

structural_findings.feedback_cycle: Research01's broad assembly proposal -> Research05 actual receipt and overlap/self-pivot feedback -> Research01 actual receipt -> specific revised coverage -> subsequent Research07/08 adoption. Research05's pre-existing pivot is not counted as adoption of a later assignment.
structural_findings.not_claimed: Exclusive fixed roles, compelled authority, causal necessity, identity symmetry, leader replacement or universal participation in final revisions.

structural_findings.finding: Isolated completed contribution use before an early runtime cutoff.
structural_findings.later_reads: Research02 reads Research01/06/08 artifacts, but no later completed research publication is observed.
structural_findings.not_claimed: Sustained division, an orchestrator, absence of future organization, or absence of all communication.

mathematical_findings: Intended: inspected explicit real-solenoidal constants, small-H1 and energy-enstrophy product criteria, singular-time restrictions and eventual smoothness, critical Fourier boundary/analyticity, large-background neighborhoods, 2D3C, strict-exponent continuation and exact initial-growth examples. Independent arithmetic verifies the lattice and cyclic-sine residual-certificate constants. These are limited claims conditional on stated standard foundations.

Unintended: inspected retained independent report versions, including the explicit Sobolev/product criterion, Fourier boundary, eventual time bounds and conditional residual criterion. Exact independent enumeration represents2,146,688nonzero signed lattice points and checks the retained constant certificates. Some extensions and final expositions remained unwritten.

Unintended reproducibility gaps: check_estimates.py, estimate-checks.txt, constant-audit.py and proof-audit.md are referenced but absent at cutoff. verification.txt was overwritten with another author's checker output; the earlier exact-enstrophy output survives in a preserved copy and native receipts. Those paths do not certify unperformed checks.

No arbitrary-data global-smoothness proof, actual singular Navier-Stokes solution, formal certification or exhaustive literature/novelty review is claimed. Mathematical success and organizational structure are evaluated separately.
temporal_findings: Intended begins with overlapping plans and independent assembly nominations; feedback and self-chosen pivots precede differentiated task requests. A central assembly/review function develops while lateral peer negotiations and mathematical improvement chains continue.

The organizing member remains Research01 within the observed interval, but the participating activities change: exploration, targeted work, cross-checks, assembly, review, then solitary finishing. This is evidence of changing workflow; no leadership turnover or structure dissolution is established.

All seven other intended members naturally finish by09:13:38.342. Research01 revises the primary report at09:14:04 and09:15:39, then finishes at09:18:29.865. Later review requests have no actual recipient exposures. Earlier peer audits do not validate those final revisions; no wake-up was supplied.

Unintended shows an early checker-use chain, then competing full reports and late cross-reads. It closes at09:26:00.500359 after runtime failure, rather than natural completion. Both previous and terminal bytes remain retained; path names are not authorship or integration evidence.
limits: One descriptive pair of one problem cannot estimate a formation rate or establish a causal effect. Condition order is intended thenunintended.
The condition difference combines explicit joint-goal/peer framing and a supplied messaging convention; it does not isolate the effect of a communication channel alone.
The common report destination supplies an integration point and possible overwrite pressure. The destination itself and requested version preservation are not emergent.
Neutral numbered identities are visible in intended. Any choice ofResearch01 may reflect label salience; identity symmetry is not assumed from equal model/task inputs.

Observed receipt and subsequent action support observational adoption,not intervention-based causal influence. Mathematical citation,centrality,self-nomination and last-edit status alone do not establish an orchestrator.
Autonomous stopping, resource caps and runtime failures have distinct meanings. No wakeups after autonomous completion; later stabilization,leadership turnover or dissolution may remain unobserved.
Primary-operator review is not a blinded independent second rating. No formal PDE proof certification or exhaustive novelty search was performed.
Mathematical checks retain exact hypotheses and standard foundational inputs. Partial theorems do not solve arbitrary-data global regularity.
Observed tokens include cached inputs and exclude opaque retries; these counters are not monetary billing.
The four initial legacy trajectories used interface-only intended without explicit joint-task framing. They are preserved in a separate report and release,not pooled as repetitions of this pair.
